# Bit & Byte Ideas

> Bit & Byte Ideas builds and runs the websites and software small businesses need to grow,
> so the owner never has to think about the technical side. Websites are custom-designed,
> not templated; the software behind them is built, hosted, and maintained on a monthly plan.
> Contact: info@bitandbyteideas.com | Response time: within 24 hours.

## Services

- **Website & Application Development** — Custom-designed static sites through full
  applications with logins, dashboards, and business logic. No templates. Mobile-first,
  SEO-optimized, Core Web Vitals performance. Pricing: quote-based.

- **Business Automation & Integrations** — Connects the software a business already uses
  (CRM, invoicing, forms, e-commerce, email) so information flows automatically, plus
  custom API integrations when no off-the-shelf connector exists. Pricing: quote-based.

- **Maintenance + Hosting** — Monthly care plan with managed hosting. Includes automated backups,
  security patches, performance monitoring, and priority support for minor changes.

## About

- Studio type: Independent software studio
- Founded: 2024
- Location: San Diego, California, United States (serving clients across the US, remote-first)
- Founder: Carlos Barajas — engineer with 18+ years across fintech, energy, and financial services
- Clients: Small and medium businesses
- Currently: Accepting new clients
- Email: info@bitandbyteideas.com
- Free consultation: 30-minute discovery call, no commitment

## Differentiators

- Custom website design — no templates or page builders
- English and Spanish websites for businesses with Spanish-speaking customers
- Clients own their website; software is licensed under the plan with an option to buy it outright
- Performance-first: static prerendered pages, Core Web Vitals optimized
- SEO built into every build
- Hosting, security, and upkeep handled on a monthly care plan
